liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments were broadly unchanged at {{cash_like@FY2025}}, and with {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} of undrawn committed facilities liquidity reached {{liquidity@FY2025}}, or {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}} of revenue.
Debt due within one year fell by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, covered {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2025}} by liquidity, so near-term maturities are met without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, equal to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}} of debt, as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2025}} to {{net_capex@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments rose, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}} and advance ticket cover up {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, so a larger share of the cash belongs to customers; the group also entered into a new revolving credit facility that replaced its previous facilities.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, and free cash flow after leases declined by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}} as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2025}}.
Profitability: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} is the lowest of the low-cost group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}}), against a peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, above the level of a year earlier, which raises the sensitivity of the cash position to bookings.

Interest: coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2025}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2025}} as finance costs rose by {{finance_costs.change@FY2025}} to {{finance_costs@FY2025}}, with airline net financing charges up on lower interest income on cash and higher charges on borrowings.
